Container.Name: hardpoint-planner
Container.Overview: Star Citizen loadout optimizer. Picks the best weapons, shields, power plants, coolers and quantum drive for any ship, shows which stores sell each part and on which planet, explains what each ship is best at, and answers questions about your ship using Google Gemini. Game data and store prices refresh automatically.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stores the refreshed game data and prices.

Config.Name: Gemini API key
Config.Description: Get one free at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave empty to turn off the question box.

Config.Name: Gemini models
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated list to limit and order models, e.g. gemini-3.6-flash,gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Empty = every text model your key can use.

Config.Name: Update interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often to refresh game data and store prices. 0 turns automatic updates off.

Config.Name: Max price age (days)
Config.Description: Ignore store listings older than this many days.

Config.Name: UEX API token
Config.Description: Optional. Only needed if UEX starts requiring a token for price data.

Config.Name: Questions per 10 minutes
Config.Description: Per-device limit so nobody burns through your Gemini quota.
